```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```


# Load data

```{r load data}
db <- read.csv("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/data/co-med-io/clindat_2020-05-01.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)
cancers <- unique(db$cancer.name)
```


# Survival: All samples

```{r}
all_surv <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = db)

ggsurvplot(all_surv, pval = T, risk.table = T)
```

# Survival: Split cancers

## Create models

```{r}
mods.list <- list()

for(d in cancers){
  tmp <- db %>%
    filter(cancer.name == d)
  tmp.fit <- surv_fit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = tmp)
  mods.list[[d]] <- tmp.fit
}
```

## Display plots

```{r}
lapply(cancers, function(x) try(ggsurvplot(mods.list[[x]], pval = T, risk.table = T, title = x)))
```
